final_fence_definition: The exact final product/test write fence is the set union defined by WRITE_SCOPE_RELEASED_V2.json and the nine literal maintained Cargo.lock paths in CANONICALIZER_CONSUMER_LOCK_FENCE_V1.json. No glob, directory or inferred adjacent path is authorized.
lock_change_limit: Only minimal dependency-graph accommodation required by the approved canonicalizer serde dependency; no unrelated version upgrades or churn and no historical execution locks.
permissions: Build-only lease remains unchanged; this extension adds tracked lock scope only.
